name: Select MFA Type - Passkey
summary: A user on Select MFA Type chooses Passkey and is handed off to the existing Passkey Start surface.

sourceReferences.note: The behavior starts on the canonical Select MFA Type surface.
The behavior ends at the existing Passkey Start surface.
Angular implementation routes action:select-passkey to the existing passkey continuation route.
React Native implementation routes action:select-passkey to /auth/continue/passkey.
Select MFA Type contains one Passkey behavior composed of exactly one UI-only scenario.
